breakdown.description: Counter-flow flame requires opposing inlet velocities; both inlets set to +x
breakdown.reason: The user's original request specified a counter-flow flame but incorrectly set both inlet velocities in the same positive x-direction. The agent correctly identified that a counter-flow configuration requires opposing velocities and set the `leftFuel` velocity to `+0.1 m/s` in the `+x` direction and the `rightAir` velocity to `-0.1 m/s` in the `-x` direction, thus resolving the inconsistency.
